blurb: Baywood Greens offers a championship golf experience with 18 holes divided into Woodside Nine and Waterside Nine. The course features handcrafted timber bridges, tunnels, lakes, and extensive botanical gardens. Amenities include a practice facility, putting and chipping greens, private lessons, clinics, a clubhouse restaurant, locker rooms, and a pro shop.
